verdict.rationale: Poly is a cloud file-storage and AI product, so running without the vendor's cloud is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows only that it depends on Poly's cloud: files sync to Poly storage, download on demand, and the MCP endpoint is hosted at mcp.poly.app. Offline edit queues and pinned downloads are adjacent caching features, not a local-only mode or a self-hosted sync backend, and no such option is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the whole system without the vendor's cloud — local-only mode or a self-hosted sync backend I operate myself
